requirements.name: Execution placement
requirements.description: Where must interactive and asynchronous coding-agent execution run?

requirements.name: Runtime isolation
requirements.description: What minimum isolation boundary must separate coding-agent execution?

requirements.name: Asynchronous tasks
requirements.description: Must agents execute unattended issue-to-pull-request tasks?

requirements.name: Long-running workspaces
requirements.description: Are persistent workspaces required for migrations or durable development environments?

requirements.name: Multiple coding agents
requirements.description: Must the platform coordinate multiple coding agents or specialist workers?

requirements.name: Multiple model providers
requirements.description: Must the platform route across more than one model provider?

requirements.name: Model provider hosting
requirements.description: How are model providers hosted and reached through the model gateway?

requirements.name: Model fallback
requirements.description: Is automatic provider or model fallback required?

requirements.name: Residency-aware routing
requirements.description: Must model routing enforce region or data-residency constraints?

requirements.name: Restricted egress
requirements.description: Must runtime network egress be restricted to approved destinations?

requirements.name: Private connectivity
requirements.description: Must model, tool, and enterprise API traffic use private connectivity?

requirements.name: Source control system
requirements.description: Which source-control and pull-request system is authoritative?

requirements.name: Approved package registries
requirements.description: May coding agents download packages only from approved registries?

requirements.name: Enterprise identity
requirements.description: Which workforce identity provider and group source must authorize developers?

requirements.name: Developer population
requirements.description: How many developers must the platform support?

requirements.name: Concurrent agent tasks
requirements.description: How many concurrent coding-agent tasks must be supported?

requirements.name: Approved regions
requirements.description: May workloads run in any approved region or only a fixed region set?

requirements.name: Action-dependent approval
requirements.description: Must approval requirements vary by the risk of the action?

requirements.name: Audit retention
requirements.description: How many days must agent decisions and actions remain replayable?

requirements.name: Team boundaries
requirements.description: Must teams receive separate policy, quota, and audit workspaces?

requirements.name: Outcome observability
requirements.description: Must agent traces correlate with Git and CI outcomes?

requirements.name: Economic priority
requirements.description: Should routing optimize cost, quality, latency, or a balanced outcome?

requirements.name: Agent orchestration mode
requirements.description: Should agents work independently, hand off sequentially, or produce parallel candidates for review?

requirements.name: Model routing mode
requirements.description: Should model assignments be static or selected dynamically by policy?

requirements.name: Warm runtime capacity
requirements.description: Must the platform keep warm runtimes or resumable snapshots to meet startup SLOs?
